verdict.rationale: Postmark documents broad API coverage well beyond sending. This includes templates (create, edit, list, validate, push to another server), servers, message streams, domains (DKIM/SPF/Return-Path verification, DKIM rotation), sender signatures, bounces, message search, inbound retry and bypass, stats, and webhooks. That suggests extensive API parity with the UI, but no source states that everything in the UI is available through the API. missing for 10: an explicit UI–API parity statement, API evidence for add-ons such as DMARC monitoring, dedicated IPs, custom retention and billing/account settings, a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none), and independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
